fields.name: meshId
fields.label: API Mesh ID
fields.description: API Mesh identifier used to build the GraphQL endpoint.

fields.name: graphqlEndpoint
fields.label: GraphQL Endpoint
fields.description: API Mesh GraphQL URL (server-side). Browser uses Product Detail Proxy Endpoint instead.

fields.name: productDetailProxyEndpoint
fields.label: Product Detail Proxy Endpoint
fields.description: App Builder proxy for browser product detail GraphQL requests (CORS-safe).

fields.name: graphqlApiKey
fields.label: GraphQL API Key
fields.description: Optional x-api-key header for API Mesh requests.

fields.name: skuQueryParam
fields.label: SKU Query Parameter
fields.description: URL query parameter used to identify the product (for example ?sku=VA02).

fields.name: mockApiEndpoint
fields.label: Mock API Endpoint
fields.description: Same-origin mock JSON used on localhost when GraphQL is unavailable.
